```artifact
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Patient
    participant Doctor
    participant Admin
    participant Chemist
    participant Lab
    participant System

    Patient->>Doctor: Generate consultation request
    Doctor->>System: Retrieve consultation request
    System-->>Doctor: Display consultation request
    Doctor->>System: Provide diagnosis
    System->>Patient: Notify diagnosis

    Doctor->>System: Generate prescription
    System->>Patient: Send prescription
    System->>Chemist: Send prescription
    System->>Lab: Send prescription

    Chemist->>System: Receive prescription
    System-->>Chemist: Confirm delivery request
    Chemist->>Patient: Deliver medicines

    Lab->>System: Receive prescription
    System-->>Lab: Confirm specimen collection request
    Lab->>Patient: Collect specimen
    Lab->>System: Submit lab report
    System-->>Patient: Deliver lab report
    System->>System: Update report for future reference
```
